items.quote: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.
items.contrast: Whether “them” refers to the towers or to the gates.
items.reason: The towers are what Uzziah built, while the gates identify their locations, so “them” refers to the towers. Resolving that pronoun reference distinguishes the key from the plausible gate misreading.
